address: Olivia Centre, Aleja Grunwaldzka 472c, Gdańsk, 80-309, Poland
bio: Located way up on the 33rd floor of northern Poland’s tallest building, this restaurant affords views over Gdańsk and out to the Baltic Sea. The cooking is equally spectacular, underpinned by Polish produce, driven by Spanish flavours and incorporating a few Italian influences. The superb jamón risotto is a prime example, with the rice infused with melted fat for an intense, meaty flavour. The service is smooth and charming, while the wine list is a treasure trove for oenophiles....
